properties.description: **Essential** — Baseline hygiene for Azure Stack Edge: the non-negotiable controls every deployment should enforce from day one. This tier delivers encryption-at-rest with service-managed keys. Together these policies protect against credential theft, unencrypted data exposure, and accidental data loss. Maps to CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001 Annex A.10 (cryptography) and A.12 (operations).

metadata.policyName: Azure Stack Edge devices should use double-encryption
